QUOTE: Polls an `int*` cancel flag every 10 ms and raises an `std::atomic<bool>` for the backend ... The C ABI forces the `int*` shape, so the fix is to have the C side take an `std::atomic<int>*`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the poller bridging an int* to an atomic, but it frames this as a data-race gap to fix. It never says the thread exists because the C ABI cannot carry an atomic.
